moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! Continues
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! is currently airing nightly on ITV1, with celebrities like Wayne Rooney and Joanna Page in the Australian jungle.

angles.name: Tonight's Jungle Drama
angles.copy: Another night, another Bushtucker Trial! What are your predictions for who faces the critters in I'm A Celeb tonight? Catch all the jungle drama on ITV1.

angles.name: Campmate Chatter
angles.copy: From Wayne Rooney's jungle antics to Joanna Page's camp confessions, the I'm A Celeb camp is buzzing. Who's your favourite to be crowned King or Queen of the Jungle so far?

angles.name: Late Arrival Impact
angles.copy: Leigh Francis shook things up as a late arrival in the jungle this week! How do you think Keith Lemon's alter ego will fare with the remaining campmates?

moments.title: Autumn Nations Series Finals Weekend Approaches
moments.blurb: The inaugural Autumn Nations Championship concludes next weekend with a Finals Weekend at Twickenham, following today's final round of group matches including England vs New Zealand and Ireland vs South Africa.

angles.name: Twickenham Showdown
angles.copy: All eyes on Twickenham next weekend as the Autumn Nations Series culminates in a blockbuster Finals Weekend! Who are you backing to lift the trophy?

angles.name: England's Victory Today
angles.copy: What a performance! England beat New Zealand 37-12 today at Twickenham in the Autumn Nations Series. A great result heading into the Finals Weekend!

angles.name: Wales' Big Match
angles.copy: Wales will face Australia as part of the Autumn Nations Series Finals Weekend at Twickenham. Huge match for the Welsh squad!

moments.title: Black Friday & Cyber Monday Deals Ramp Up
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially lands on November 27th, followed by Cyber Monday on November 30th, with many retailers already launching their sales events this week.

angles.name: Early Bird Deals
angles.copy: Black Friday is still days away, but the deals have already started! Are you an early bird shopper or waiting for the big day on November 27th?

angles.name: Cyber Monday Tech
angles.copy: Get ready for Cyber Monday on November 30th – historically the best day for online tech deals! What gadgets are on your wishlist this year?

angles.name: Shopping Weekend Plan
angles.copy: It's a big week for shoppers! Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, and Cyber Monday. Where are you planning to bag a bargain?

moments.title: Björk Turns 61 Today
moments.blurb: Icelandic avant-garde pop icon Björk celebrates her 61st birthday today, November 21st, known for her distinctive voice and innovative music spanning decades.

angles.name: Celebrating Björk's Vision
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Björk! Her visionary music has pushed boundaries for decades. What's your favourite track from the Icelandic legend?

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: From 'Debut' to 'Homogenic,' Björk's albums are masterpieces. Which of her innovative records holds a special place in your heart?

moments.title: Carly Rae Jepsen is 41 Today
moments.blurb: Canadian pop singer-songwriter Carly Rae Jepsen, globally known for her hit 'Call Me Maybe,' celebrates her 41st birthday today, November 21st.

angles.name: Call Her Maybe for Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 41st birthday to pop sensation Carly Rae Jepsen! Still can't get 'Call Me Maybe' out of our heads. What's your favourite CRJ track?

angles.name: Pop Perfection
angles.copy: Celebrating Carly Rae Jepsen's 41st today! Her knack for crafting perfect pop songs is undeniable. What's the ultimate CRJ earworm for you?

moments.title: Miley Cyrus Turns 34 on Monday
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actress Miley Cyrus, known for her evolving artistry and numerous hits, will celebrate her 34th birthday on Monday, November 23rd.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Miley
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Miley Cyrus turns 34 on Monday. From 'Hannah Montana' to 'Flowers', she's never stopped evolving. What's your favourite Miley era?

angles.name: Miley's Greatest Hits
angles.copy: Ahead of her 34th birthday on Monday, what's the Miley Cyrus song that defines her incredible career for you? So many to choose from!

moments.title: Amy Grant to Celebrate 66th Birthday
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer-songwriter Amy Grant, known for her crossover success in contemporary Christian and pop music, will turn 66 on Wednesday, November 25th.

angles.name: Celebrating Amy Grant
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the incredible Amy Grant this Wednesday! Her timeless songs continue to inspire across generations. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Crossover Queen
angles.copy: Amy Grant's music effortlessly blends genres. As she celebrates her 66th on Wednesday, we're looking back at her amazing career. Which of her hits do you love most?

moments.title: Rita Ora Turns 36 on Thursday
moments.blurb: British singer, songwriter, and TV personality Rita Ora, known for UK chart-topping hits and her vibrant presence, will celebrate her 36th birthday on Thursday, November 26th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rita!
angles.copy: Get ready to party! Rita Ora turns 36 on Thursday. From 'Hot Right Now' to her latest tracks, she always brings the energy. What's your favourite Rita Ora anthem?
